newsitem.title: USA: Meridian launches new auto-inject product.
newsitem.headline: Meridian launches new auto-inject product.

text.p: Meridian Medical Technologies Inc said Wednesday it has launched TruJect, a pen-like, spring-activated pre-filled auto-injector that permits patients to self-administer dosages of injectable drugs.
The company already produces the EpiPen and Epi E-ZPen auto-injectors, which are used by patients to self-inject epinephrine for allergic reactions.

Meridian said it is now working with a growing number of pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in the development of new products, and has recently announced strategic alliances with Mylan Laboratories Inc and Canadian based Genpharm Inc.
Meridian develops auto-injector delivery systems and cardiopulmonary products.
